classification_audit.retry_denial_basis: Budget extrapolation is observed model behavior and ModelOutputObserved is KNOWN(true); retry is allowed only for confirmed INFRA_FAILURE with KNOWN(false) output.

mandatory_preconditions: Preserve the 9c047 cell invocation, prompt, output, events and receipt byte-for-byte; never repeat it, and retain INVALID_OUTPUT with policy score zero in the ITT denominator.

Publish a bounded redesign that mechanically counts every terminal Bateia cycle, including invalid-parameter failures and polling calls, and prevents a twenty-sixth call without increasing the immutable maximum of 25.

Demonstrate the guard deterministically on synthetic 25-call and 26-call event streams without executing a model or MCP session, including fail-closed accounting when no final schema-valid output exists.
Bind the redesigned controller or execution profile, unchanged queue, prompt, schema, tool allowlist and per-cell budgets in a successor manifest and execution seal.
Obtain an independent focal verification of that successor seal and budget guard before unpausing automation or dispatching another cell.
Resume first with one distinct CONTRACT treatment cell as a canary; audit it before authorizing the rest of the remaining CONTRACT queue.
Keep VALIDATION and TEST blocked until all 18 CONTRACT cells are accounted for and an explicit final CONTRACT gate passes.
prohibited_actions: Do not reclassify the observed failure as INFRA_FAILURE, TOOL_UNAVAILABLE or VALID_OUTPUT.
Do not retry, replace, exclude or mutate 9c047.
Do not raise max_bateia_calls above 25 or weaken any other frozen budget.
Do not unpause passo-29-contract or dispatch the reserved next cell under the current unguarded execution design.
Do not enter VALIDATION or TEST based on this focal audit.
eventual_continuation_assessment.reason: This is the first observed call-budget failure and exposes a concrete missing enforcement boundary, so a bounded redesign with a new mechanical witness is proportionate. Continuing the existing executor would risk the same semantic violation and is therefore fail-closed.

limitations: The verifier audited captured bytes, frozen manifests and local automation configuration but did not rerun the model, MCP server or external dispatcher.
The automation status is mutable external state; PAUSED is attested only at the recorded verification time and TOML hash.
The shared workspace does not provide strong independent isolation attestation.
The event stream exposes no per-tool timestamps, so lifecycle pairing and canonical hashes are verified but individual tool durations are not independently recomputable.
This focal report does not authorize resumption, pass the final CONTRACT gate, judge output quality or demonstrate uplift.
self_hash_policy: SHA-256 of RFC8259 UTF-8 JSON canonicalized with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace and unescaped Unicode, after removing the top-level self_hash field.
invalidation_rule: Any byte change to the audited queue, plan, prompt contract, schema, profile, R4 seal, corpus, cell invocation/prompt/output/events/stderr/receipt or execution state requires a successor focal verification; automation status must be rechecked immediately before any future resumption decision.
